name: metr_point_v0_tail_guard_half
rationale: Two strongly active negative-readout features coincide with underestimation across many calibration windows. Separate 10% tail repairs each lowered both MAE and MSE with negative paired confidence intervals. Encode both threshold repairs in two practically disconnected neurons, now removing half the suppressive contribution beyond the threshold. This is an explicit local rule, not fitted coefficients; no gradients, training, optimizer or test examples. The original circuits, thresholds, and positive-output paths are retained.
